svg.title: Residual calibration, B-spline kernel transformation and differentiable physics
svg.desc: Editable schematic of bounded NWP residual calibration, evaluation of four adjacent cubic B-spline basis functions at one common density-equivalent wind speed, constrained weighted sum and cut-in/cut-out gate, and two gradient-feedback paths from prediction loss. Basis and power curves are schematic, not experimental observations.

g.text: Evaluate all four bases at the same u
